The second phase surrounded by 3-story buildings and a parking floor in -1 as well as Duplex and Penthouse Apartments. Reservations are only 10,000 euros initially Payment is made in installments as the case may be (the apartment or the client's option) ) Up to 70% of the value without collateral and good interest with Credence Bank at this stage The actual price per m2 is a bargain, as the market is still up.
